instruction: Create a clear graphic analysis of monthly time charged to each department from 2022 to current. In the 'Data' sheet, each row is a department and each column from the first month header contains that department's total time for the month. On a new 'Analysis' sheet, convert the time values to total hours, lay them out in a summary table (departments as rows, months as columns), and build a multi-series line chart showing the monthly trend per department. Label axes appropriately and ensure the chart uses the month headers as the X-axis and hours as the Y-axis.
